title: The same bump as a normal lockfile change: new version, new integrity hash, same registry, no install script, no new package (clean control)

proof.shell:
W=$PWD; T=$(mktemp -d); cp -r base/. $T/ && cd $T && patch -p1 -s < $W/change.patch && python3 - <<'PYEND'
import json
lk = json.load(open("package-lock.json"))["packages"]
assert {v["resolved"].split("/")[2] for k, v in lk.items() if k and "resolved" in v} == {"registry.npmjs.org"}
assert not any(v.get("hasInstallScript") for v in lk.values()) and set(lk) == {"", "node_modules/left-trim", "node_modules/tiny-slugger"}
assert lk["node_modules/tiny-slugger"]["version"] == "2.0.4"

PYEND
